flow.name: REST API for sending reminder of Overdue mantises from past 7 days

route1.js: message.env.email = message.content.email; message.content.overDueMantis= message.content.mantises ; message.env.name= message.content.name; message.content.table = true;

route3.js: message.logsMsg = message.content; message.content = {}; message.content.html = message.logsMsg; delete message.logsMsg; let monthNames = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June','July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];const currentDate = new Date (); message.content.title = `⚠️ Overdue Mantises since 7 days - ${message.env.name} - ${currentDate.getDate()} ${monthNames[currentDate.getMonth()]} ${currentDate.getFullYear()} `; message.content.to = message.env.email;
